roster.updateAnalysis: Update analysis — read changed scenes into the ledgers (the same run as the console)
roster.empty: No threads yet — analysis populates these.

dups.explain: These threads share a handle — likely one promise re-opened. Open each to compare, then merge to fold them into the earliest.
dups.recastTitle: A member supersedes another (succeeds) — an intentional recast, not a duplicate. Not mergeable.
dups.mergeTitle: Fold these into one thread (the earliest opener)

entity.empty: Nothing tracked yet — run analysis to discover the items and factions your scenes feature.

map.looseThread: Loose thread — opened but never developed or resolved. Often noise (a one-off event, or an unconnected payoff). Review or prune.

detail.inferredTitle: The analysis agent's reading of your dialogue.

whatIsAThread.title: What a thread is
items: A **thread** is a promise or question the story opens and (maybe) pays off — a mystery, a goal, a conflict.
Its status is a **fold over its events**: a *resolve* closes it, a later *reopen* re-opens it. The close-gate is what would pay it off.
A thread can fork into **strands** (per subject) — e.g. one layoff thread, one strand per person.

rows.lane color: the archetype (mystery · promise · conflict · task · foreshadowing)
rows.● open: the event that opened the thread
rows.◆ resolve: an event that closes it (the gate is met)
rows.◌ reopen: a later event that re-opens a closed thread
rows.columns: scenes in reading order — click one to read it
rows.chapter bands: the wrap-layer groups scenes by folder; toggle with the layers button

sheet.title: The Sheet (click a thread)
items: The sheet is a **chapter railway**: each chapter is a **station** — a filled stop (●) where the thread has events, a hollow stop (○ ··) for a chapter it stays **quiet**, a **◆ terminus** where it resolves.

Events are **cards** under their station (so each names just its scene). Click one to expand its full moment, the **“evidence”** dialogue it was drawn from, the surrounding **scene context**, and its cast.
The hollow stops between stations show how long a thread goes **silent** — a slow burn, or a thread left hanging.

provenance.title: Provenance — this is the agent's reading
items: Threads are **inferred** by the analysis agent from your dialogue — they are its understanding, not authored truth.
Each event carries a **confidence**; low values (highlighted) are worth a second look before you trust a close.
Re-running analysis after you edit a scene refreshes the threads it touched.
